_doc: Classes (BL4 style): each tree has its own action skill; you equip one (loadout.action = tree id). Passives (points, ranks) are generic ability.* / player.* stats and work with whichever skill is equipped. Augments are free: a tree's augment unlocks when the tree reaches its tier; up to augmentSlots are equipped, from the equipped skill's tree. One capstone (a point, any tree) works with whichever skill is equipped. Tiers open every `tierPoints` points spent in that tree.

charge.note: Action skills charge like BO6/BO7 field upgrades: the meter fills over the skill's cooldown, and each of your own kills (bullets, melee) adds this share of a full charge (headshot and melee add more). Locked until the power is on; starts empty each game. Balance pass: a kill's share is scaled by min(1, ref/cooldown), and Recycler's bank covers at most bankCap of the meter.

tour.desc: Win every game in your pool once (the punch card on the rack) and the Grand Tour runs every one of their specials at once for 20s, plus 2 Fortune per game. The card then starts over.

run.marker: Each bust fills the Marker; once it's full (3 busts), the next bust pays as a win (MARKER PAID). Any win clears it.
run.ride: After a win: Z lets it ride on a coin flip (a win pays one tier up, a loss busts), R cashes out. Up to 3 rides.
run.reshuffle: Command wheel: deal the game again for 4 Fortune.
run.hand: Cards wait in your hand (3): Z plays the top one while Ante Up charges, or pick one on the command wheel.

synergies.name: Ace High
synergies.desc: The card Wild Draw deals you is an Ace of Spades or a Wild Card.

synergies.name: Trick Shot
synergies.desc: Bank Shot works at any Fortune, and ricochets count as kills for the game.

trees.name: Luck of the Draw
trees.desc: Cards: a hand to hold and play.

action.name: Ante Up
action.desc: Hold Z for the ante wheel and put something on the table for a while (points, health, your gun, a perk or the skill's own clock); a casino game deals itself across your screen: blackjack, bone dice or the one-armed bandit, more as the trees unlock them. Your gun tilts the odds while it plays: kills, headshots and multikills peek, nudge and re-roll. Z and R make the calls. Wins pay out gun power-ups, cards to play and totems; jackpots start High Roller Mode.

nodes.name: Card Counter
nodes.desc: House Edge −{v}% on every ante you put up.

nodes.name: Sleight of Hand
nodes.desc: Reload speed +{v}%.

nodes.name: Poker
nodes.desc: Adds Poker to your games: five cards, kills rank up your lowest card, two headshots in a row make a wild. Z or R locks the hand; when the clock runs out the loose cards are drawn again. Its wins pay Poker Face (headshots deal double damage, every 3rd headshot kill deals a card).

nodes.name: Card Shark
nodes.desc: Cards you play hit +{v}% harder.

nodes.name: Wild Draw
nodes.desc: Every Run deals you a card as it starts.

nodes.name: Double Down
nodes.desc: Wins have a {v}% chance to pay one more reward.

nodes.name: Split Hand
nodes.desc: A card you play has a 35% chance to come back to your hand.

nodes.name: Dead Man's Hand
nodes.desc: Below 40% health, gun damage +{v}% for each card in your hand.

nodes.name: Cold Deck
nodes.desc: Playing a card freezes the zombies within 260 for 2s.

nodes.name: Devil's Tines
nodes.desc: One more augment slot, and every win deals you a card on top of its payout.

nodes.name: Fistful of Dice
nodes.desc: Adds Fistful of Dice to your games: five dice to fill with one face. A kill may hold a die, a melee kill sets one, Z re-rolls the loose dice once. Its wins pay Rolling Thunder (kills may blow up the body).

nodes.name: Big Medicine
nodes.desc: Totems follow you around instead of staying where they were planted.

nodes.desc: Totem damage +{v}%.

nodes.desc: The Marker pays out {v} bust sooner.

nodes.desc: Dice games that pay also plant a random totem at your feet.

nodes.name: Comeback Roll
nodes.desc: Ante Up cooldown −{v}%.

nodes.name: Pair of Fives
nodes.desc: A bust gives back 50% of the meter.

nodes.name: All In
nodes.desc: Let It Ride goes up to 4 times at +10% odds, and losing a ride still pays your first win.

trees.name: Chaos Walking
trees.desc: The wheel and the hot streak.

nodes.name: Nudge

nodes.name: Windfall Odds

nodes.name: Roulette
nodes.desc: Adds Roulette to your games: you bet a colour and a lucky number. Kills brake the wheel when that lands it on your colour, headshots knock it a pocket on. Its wins pay House Spin (each kill refills your mag, arcs to 3 zombies, or rarely freezes them all).

nodes.name: Hot Streak
nodes.desc: Hot Streak lasts +{v}% longer and its fire rate and reload bonus grows by as much.

nodes.name: Marquee Rigged
nodes.desc: Reshuffle is free.

nodes.name: Chaos Theory
nodes.desc: High Roller Mode's seeking cards and ricochets hit +{v}% harder.

nodes.name: Bank Shot
nodes.desc: At full Fortune your bullets ricochet 25% of the time.

nodes.name: Casino Fever
nodes.desc: Fortune's gun damage bonus +{v}%.

nodes.name: Freeze Frame
nodes.desc: Big wins and jackpots freeze the zombies within 600 for 3s.

nodes.name: House Rules
nodes.desc: You pick the game every Run (R changes it on the ante wheel), Reshuffle is free and the House Edge is halved.

classes.name: Gardener
classes.tagline: Plants it, feeds it, and lets the round come to it.

resource.name: Sunlight
resource.desc: Kills give 1 Sunlight and Sundials make more. Each point adds .2% plant damage. Bloom spends 40: every sprout finishes at once and every plant gains 20 s of age.

pod.name: Echo Pod
pod.desc: Remembers your last shots and fires them again at half damage.

thorn.name: Grudge Thorn
thorn.desc: Hurts every zombie close by and marks it: your bullets hit marked zombies 10% harder. Kills grow its spikes.
thorn.ancient: Marks last 3 s after a zombie leaves.

bulb.name: Sundial
bulb.desc: Makes 1 Sunlight every 4 s and slows zombies in its shade by 25%.

burr.name: Hitchhiker Burr
burr.desc: Throws burrs at zombies that pass. A burred zombie takes 35% more damage and bleeds; when it dies the burr hops to the next one, up to 3 times.

bean.name: Jumping Bean
bean.desc: Step on it to be thrown into the air. Zombies on it are tossed, hurt and stunned.

mint.name: Penny Mint
mint.desc: Kills close by store points in its leaves, up to 600. Melee it to collect them.

gourd.name: Hollow Gourd
gourd.desc: Swallows zombies that come close. Shoot it, or wait 12 s, and it bursts: the more it holds, the harder. Bursting ends the plant.

lily.name: Prism Lily
lily.desc: A beam that burns one zombie at a time and heats up to 2.5× on the same target. 50% stronger near a Sundial.

flower.name: Corpse Flower
flower.desc: Tough and foul: gas hurts up to 10 zombies close by, and every 25 s its stench pulls in up to 12 for 8 s. Every 12 seconds a zombie killed in its reach gets up as a thrall for 10 seconds.

maw.name: Glutton Maw
maw.desc: Bites a zombie every 3 s for up to 1.5× a zombie’s health. Each kill makes it stronger; after 6 bites it stops to digest for 6 s. A quarter of its meals leave an ingredient that matches what it ate.
maw.ancient: Each bite also catches its neighbours for half.

melon.name: Melon Lobber
melon.desc: Lobs an exploding melon every 5 s at the biggest crowd in reach.

vine.name: Tetherwood
vine.desc: Ties up to 5 zombies in reach together for 30 seconds. Damage to one is shared with the others at 40%.

spore.name: Mind Cap
spore.desc: Every 8 seconds it puffs, and up to 6 zombies in reach turn on each other for 4 seconds. Three puffs.

choir.name: Choir Lily
choir.desc: Replays your last shots as beams, and each beam splits into a fan of 3 zombies.

royalty.name: Royalty Pod
royalty.desc: Replays your last shots, and every replayed hit pays you 10 points.

revenant.name: Revenant Pod
revenant.desc: Every 14 seconds it raises a thrall for 10 seconds. Each of its bites hits like half of your last shot.

rider.name: Bramble Rider
rider.desc: A burr that sheds thorns: the zombie it rides makes others within 70 bleed.

pitcher.name: Pitcher Maw
pitcher.desc: Swallows up to 4 zombies and dissolves one every 4 seconds into an ingredient.

thornmaw.name: Thornmaw
thornmaw.desc: Bites, and every bite grows a spike it spits at the nearest zombie in reach.

bloodweb.name: Bloodweb
bloodweb.desc: Ties up to 5 zombies together, and every one of them bleeds while tied.

puppet.name: Puppet Gourd
puppet.desc: Swallows up to 5 zombies, then lets them out on your side for 10 seconds.

daydream.name: Daydream Bloom
daydream.desc: Zombies that stand in its shade fall asleep for up to 12 seconds, until something hits them. They can’t doze off again for 18 seconds.

solar.name: Solar Lens
solar.desc: A beam of sunlight sweeps around it, burning every zombie it crosses.

catapult.name: Catapult Gourd
catapult.desc: Swallows up to 5 zombies, then flings them at the biggest crowd within 900. They crush what they land on.
catapult.ancient: Landing reach grows by a third.

tick.name: Brain Tick
tick.desc: The zombie carrying it fights for you for 10 seconds, then the tick jumps to the next one.

patriarch.name: The Melon Patriarch
patriarch.riddle: Something sweet grows heavy under a low moon.
patriarch.desc: Lobs giant melons that split in two, and split again. When the round ends it drops a Golden Melon.

worldroot.name: World Root
worldroot.riddle: Bury what fell, and what falls is held.
worldroot.desc: Roots grab zombies climbing through windows in its reach. If you go down in its reach it holds you up, once per round, at full health.

kudzu.name: Kudzu Queen
kudzu.riddle: Bind the spite and feed it: it will never ask for ground again.
kudzu.desc: Every 20 seconds it plants a half-strength copy of a plant nearby, free of plots. Up to 4 at once, for 45 seconds each.

grave.name: Graveblossom
grave.riddle: The dead rise warmer if you plant them in the coals.
grave.desc: Zombies killed in its reach get up again as burning thralls for 8 seconds.

gourmand.name: The Gourmand
gourmand.riddle: Feed it what you bled, and it will never stop asking.
gourmand.desc: Eats zombies whole, specials included. Every meal adds 4% to your gun damage until the round ends, up to double.
gourmand.ancient: Bites what stands around its meal.

beanstalk.name: Golden Beanstalk
beanstalk.riddle: Trade the cow for something that climbs.
beanstalk.desc: Walk into it and it carries you to a nest above the map for 30 seconds, then rests for 60. Its golden pods pay 400 points every round.

overbloom.name: Overbloom
overbloom.riddle: Let the rider carry the dust, and the crowd will carry the garden.
overbloom.desc: Infects the nearest zombie. The infected fight for you, infect what they hit, and burst into a free 20-second seedling when they die. It lasts until the round ends or no infected are left.

fertilizer.name: Fertilizer
fertilizer.desc: Grows it big: +60% power, +50% health. Takes 1 more plot.

mutagen.name: Mutagen
mutagen.desc: +30% power, and it can grow one stage further than it should.

mulch.name: Mulch
mulch.desc: +40% health. Half of all bites do nothing, and it slowly heals itself.

bone.name: Bone Meal
bone.desc: Its hits can crit for double and carry on to one more zombie close by.

frost.name: Frost Dew
frost.desc: Its hits slow zombies by half for 2 seconds.

ember.name: Ember Ash
ember.desc: Its hits set zombies on fire for 3 seconds.

static.name: Static Pollen
static.desc: Its hits chain to 2 nearby zombies at half damage.

blood.name: Blood Sap
blood.desc: Each zombie it kills heals you by 8.

moon.name: Moon Soil
moon.desc: Its hits throw zombies up in the air. Found only on the Moon.

packet.name: Seed Packet
packet.desc: Plants one Uncommon seed. Found from round 4.

rare.name: Rare Seed
rare.desc: Plants one Rare seed. Found from round 10, mostly on dogs and specials.

golden.name: Golden Melon
golden.desc: 500 points, a Rare Seed and a Mutagen.

action.name: Potting Bench
action.desc: Press Z to open the bench: pick a seed, mix in up to two ingredients, and plant it where you aim. Plants grow from Sprout to Grown to Mature to Ancient, getting stronger as they survive. Melee a plant to pat it: it heals and ages faster.

nodes.desc: Adds hybrids: Pitcher Maw, Thornmaw, Bloodweb and Puppet Gourd.

nodes.desc: Adds hybrids: Daydream Bloom, Solar Lens, Catapult Gourd and Brain Tick.
